_comment: Cards that exist only for tests/unit/mana/test_return_at_next_untap.py. Never part of a deck list. `t_paradise` is Undiscovered Paradise as printed: a land that taps for any colour and goes back to its owner's hand during its activator's next untap step.

cards.name: Test Paradise
cards.oracle_text: {T}: Add one mana of any color. During your next untap step, as you untap your permanents, return this land to its owner's hand.

abilities.text: {T}: Add one mana of any color. During your next untap step, as you untap your permanents, return this land to its owner's hand.
